requirements.title: authenticated user lands on the self attendance page
acceptanceCriteria: The attendance self-view page is reachable after a valid authentication session is established
The page title or heading identifies the attendance context
preconditions: A valid synthetic test user credential is available via environment variable
A storage-state session has been established for that user
The application base URL for the target environment is configured
requirements.expectedOutcome: The attendance self-view page renders without an error state and the authenticated user's identity or the page heading is visible
requirements.source: Derived from application URL https://vyaguta.lftechnology.com/attendance/self/all — no formal requirement doc available. Requires owner approval and auth gap resolution before promotion to active.

requirements.title: self attendance view displays a list of attendance records
acceptanceCriteria: The page contains a table, list, or grid element representing attendance records
At least one record row or an explicit empty-state message is present
preconditions: The authenticated test user has at least one attendance record, or the application renders a verified empty-state message when no records exist
requirements.expectedOutcome: A record list or empty-state indicator is visible; no unhandled error message is displayed
requirements.source: Derived from application URL path segment 'all' implying a collection view. Exact column structure, pagination behaviour, and empty-state copy are unverified — requires browser access after auth is resolved.

requirements.title: unauthenticated user is redirected away from the self attendance page
acceptanceCriteria: A request to the attendance self-view URL without a valid session does not render the attendance data
The user is redirected to a login or access-denied page
preconditions: No active session cookie or token is present in the browser context
The application base URL for the target environment is configured
requirements.expectedOutcome: The browser lands on a login or error page, not the attendance record view
requirements.source: Derived from the stated requirement that the application URL requires authentication. Exact redirect target URL and page copy are unverified — requires browser access after auth mechanism is confirmed.

requirements.title: login page loads and displays the authentication form
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the login URL returns a page that renders without an error state
An email input, a password input, and a submit control are visible on the page
preconditions: The application base URL https://www.automationexercise.com/ is reachable
No authenticated session is present in the browser context
requirements.expectedOutcome: The login page renders with its form elements present and no error state visible
requirements.source: Owner specification — login feature, automationexercise.com. Selectors verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-08. Owner approved 2026-10-08.

requirements.title: valid credentials result in an authenticated session
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the pre-existing test account email and the password from TEST_PASSWORD results in a successful authentication
After submission the user is no longer on the login page and no login-error indicator is visible
preconditions: The test account configured via the TEST_EMAIL environment variable exists on the application
The TEST_PASSWORD environment variable is set to the correct password for that account
No authenticated session is present in the browser context at the start of the test
requirements.expectedOutcome: The browser navigates away from the login page; the Logout nav link becomes visible, confirming an authenticated session.
requirements.source: Owner specification — core happy-path login, automationexercise.com. CAPTCHA not enforced; Logout link used as authenticated indicator. Verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-08. Owner approved 2026-10-08.

requirements.title: invalid credentials display an error message and deny access
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting an email and password combination that does not match any registered account does not grant an authenticated session
A visible error message is displayed on the login page
The user remains on the login page after the failed attempt
preconditions: The application base URL is reachable
The email used for this test does not correspond to a valid account, or the password is intentionally incorrect
No authenticated session is present in the browser context
requirements.expectedOutcome: Error message 'Your email or password is incorrect!' is displayed; no session established; user remains on /login.
requirements.source: Owner specification — negative login path, automationexercise.com. Error text verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-08. Owner approved 2026-10-08.

requirements.title: submitting an empty login form shows a validation error
acceptanceCriteria: Activating the submit control while both the email and password fields are empty produces a visible validation indicator
preconditions: The login page is rendered with the form in its default empty state
No authenticated session is present in the browser context
requirements.expectedOutcome: A validation error or browser-native field constraint is visible; the user remains on the login page without a session
requirements.source: Owner specification — empty-form edge case, automationexercise.com. Client-side HTML5 validation confirmed via DISCOVER 2026-10-08. Owner approved 2026-10-08.
